# minarank studio

> Right now, somebody nearby is searching for what only you offer. We make
> sure they find you on Google, on the map, and in what ChatGPT says. Durres,
> Albania.

We publish this file because it costs nothing. No major provider has been
shown to read one, and we say so on the AI search page rather than selling
llms.txt as a ranking trick. It is a map, not a ranking factor. If nothing
ever fetches it, we have lost one file and no reader has lost anything.

These are the English pages. Every one of them is mirrored, record for record:
Italiano at /it/, Shqip at /sq/. Every URL on the site, in all 3 languages and
with its hreflang alternates, is in https://minarankstudio.com/sitemap.xml.

## Home
- [minarank studio · digital presence for small businesses in Durres](https://minarankstudio.com/): Right now, somebody nearby is searching for what only you offer. We make sure they find you on Google, on the map, and in what ChatGPT says. Durres, Albania.

## What we do
- [SEO and local search in Albania](https://minarankstudio.com/seo/): SEO and local search for small businesses: your Google Business Profile, on-page work on the site, and off-page work everywhere else. English, Italian and Albanian.
- [AI search in Albania, sometimes called GEO](https://minarankstudio.com/geo/): AI search, sometimes called GEO. Becoming one of the few businesses an assistant names when a customer asks it for a recommendation.
- [Web design in Albania, built to be found](https://minarankstudio.com/web-design/): Websites for small businesses: fast, clear, readable by machines, usually in three languages. Built without frameworks or third-party scripts.
- [Facebook and Instagram ads in Albania](https://minarankstudio.com/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram advertising for small businesses. A flat monthly fee, never a percentage of what you spend.
- [Custom software for small businesses in Albania](https://minarankstudio.com/systems/): Stock, jobs, customers and money in one place. We build the software small shops and trades actually run on, in Albania and Italy.

## Work
- [Work](https://minarankstudio.com/work/): Four businesses in Albania and beyond, what we built for each, and the one result with published numbers behind it.
- [Iglisi Watch](https://minarankstudio.com/work/iglisi-watch/): A family watch shop in Durres with no website at all. Three months after launch Google was sending it 741 clicks a quarter, from a standing start.
- [Victoria Boutique](https://minarankstudio.com/work/victoria-boutique/): A Durres boutique bringing Greek labels into Albania. The owner adds new pieces from her phone, in three languages, with no monthly fee and nobody to call.
- [Intimo Bruna](https://minarankstudio.com/work/intimo-bruna/): A Durres lingerie shop selling through WhatsApp, in Albanian, Italian and English, on a hand-built site with its own fonts and no third-party scripts.
- [ProAffy](https://minarankstudio.com/work/pro-affy/): Lead generation for heating and cooling firms. A site built around speed of response rather than looks, because that is what decides who gets the job.
